tools.name: atilab_get_company_facts
tools.description: Returns the official, dated facts about ATI Lab (atilab.io): positioning, who it works with, how the partnership works, founding year, headquarters and offices, services, partner programs, published results, official profiles, contact details, and the organisations with similar names that ATI Lab is

tools.name: atilab_get_site_index
tools.description: Without query, returns the atilab.io site index (llms.txt): every core page with a one-line summary. With query, returns only the index lines where every query word starts a word in that line (case-insensitive, so "automat" finds "automation"). Each page path works as input to atilab_get_page.

tools.name: atilab_get_page
tools.description: Fetches one atilab.io page as clean markdown (navigation and scripts removed), with frontmatter for title, description and canonical URL. Input is the page path ("/about", "solutions/insurance", "/" for the homepage) or a full https://www.atilab.io URL. Other domains are refused.

tools.name: atilab_get_published_results
tools.description: Returns results from ATI Lab's own production systems (e.g. shipment intake from email: 95% less manual work), each as published on atilab.io, with the source page. Optional query filters by words in the system or outcome. Industry pages on atilab.io also show third-party results from other companie

tools.name: atilab_get_contact
tools.description: Returns how to reach ATI Lab: the Growth Team at contact@atilab.io, the booking page for a strategy call, the contact page, and office locations. To send a message for the user, use atilab_send_enquiry.

tools.name: atilab_send_enquiry
tools.description: Sends the user's enquiry to ATI Lab's Growth Team, who reply by email, and returns a reference ID. The enquiry is recorded in ATI Lab's CRM. Use it only when the user has asked to contact ATI Lab and has given their name and email. Show the user the exact message first and call this only after they

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: atilab_get_page, atilab_get_published_results, atilab_get_contact · Private data: atilab_get_company_facts, atilab_get_contact, atilab_send_enquiry · Public sink: atilab_get_published_results, atilab_get_contact, atilab_send_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: atilab_get_page, atilab_get_published_results, atilab_get_contact · Private data: atilab_get_company_facts, atilab_get_contact, atilab_send_enquiry · Public sink: atilab_get_published_results, atilab_get_contact, atilab_send_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
